DT dictamen Ord. 4944/342 (16.10.1998) cited as doctrine. Thin practice evidence for c.2000.

DFL 1/2002 (published 16.01.2003) re-enacted the Code with the same Arts. 1 and 420(a); Ley 19.759 (2001) added nationality-based discrimination ban to Art. 2. Ley 20.022 (D.O. 30.05.2005) labour court reform later in 2005. Little practice evidence for c.2005.
